book.name: JAHUNEC JE CAMASAC MUDEN
book.title: Krais Uqa Anutna Jahunec Je Jon Camasac Muden

content: Anut uqa Isrel dana 144,000 sisi maden
Ceteh eu hedocob ija ensel 4-pela age maha medeh 4-pelana tatawegin fem. Age mahana fufu 4-pela gagadicca eu mahafo, macasfo, na osofo fuluadeiaunnu hewein.
Odocob ija ensel oso uqa cam tobi bena isec cali hohon fem, uqa Anut cebac bilina uqana sisi mec hewen. Uqa co suli u ensel 4-pela Anut maha macasca me qee mudoqagannu gagadic odoc aden eu utai
maaden, “Age mahafo, macasfo, nafo eu mahuc cain me qee madowain. Ege casac egena Anutna sisi mec eu uqana cewel oc dana ilomoga domonnana madeqan,” aden.
Odocob ija dana cajaca sisi madec oin eu sanijec 144,000 ec dom, eu dana cajaca 144,000 age Isrel agena sihul cunugnadec.

content.text: 12,000 age Juda sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Ruben sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Gad sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Asa sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Naptalai sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Manasa sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Simion sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Liwai sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Isaka sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Sebjulan sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Josef sihulnadec age sisi madec oin,
12,000 age Benjamin sihulnadec age sisi madec oin. Dana i cunug age Anutna sisi mec oin.

content: Dana cajaca cegulec am ben bahic age Anutnu cuha fein

Ceteh eu hedocob ija feciimig dana cajaca cegulec am ben bahic fem, oso sanijadecnu ihoc qee bilel. Dana cajaca i age dewenega filfilnadecca, sihul filfilnadecca, hatu filfilnadecca, je madec filfilnadecca age king bilec cabalca Sipsip Nagca amalana tawein. Age lotoc cecelac senenec tacecca hinahin ebenegana hewecca tawein.

content.text: “Egena Anut uqa king bilec cabalna bilinaca Sipsip Nagca ale cahahagesin eunu binanala suluquna!” ein.

content: Odocob ensel cunug age king bilec cabalca, dana matu ageca, ceteh cebac 4-pelaca taliladimeig king bilec cabal amegna toni mahuli cosolimeig Anutnu cuha fein.

content.text: “Mele bahic!
Ege egena Anut uqa kobolkobolca, doc silecca, binanca, gagadic odocca, hihibanca eunu ege gaid eeldocomun catanena,
ege hegaga ec gaid madocomun catanena!
Mele bahic!” ein.

content: Dana i age dain ben adec eu qila qee mena
Odocob dana matu eundec oso sisilti maten, “Dana cajaca lotoc cecelac senenecca tacec eundec age an? Dana cajaca eu age anadec hoin?” ten.

Odocob ija jejeg hewi madon, “O Dana Ben, ija qee dugina qa hina dogona,” don. Odocob uqa maten, “Dogona, dana cajaca i age cilehadec ben eunadec cagasiaden. Age agena lotoc cecelac wasacudein, agena lotoc eu Sipsip Nag golacna soidocobil senen men.

content.text: ‘age Anutna king bilec cabal amegna tatawi uqana tempelna cahineg witicca gaid cewel utogina.
King bilec cabalna bilina uqa agena cofadec gaid biligian.
Sipsip Nag uqa king bilec cabal gemona taweia uqa sipsip cofadec danawe cofadigian.
Eunu age haun wen qee adeiaun, wa gab qee adeiaun.
Cam haun dewenega qee cijadeiaun, dain oso qee welacadeiaun.
Odimei uqa iwaladi cocobi cebac bilec wa fifiji becna euna ehi li madigian.
Odocob Anut uqa amaga amulunuga cunug cacu heliadigian,’ en,” ten.
